name: amphibian-dev__toad
behavioral_change: pandas v_old 2.2.3 to v_new 3.0.2. Copy-on-Write became the default, so chained assignment no longer writes through, and string columns default to the new string dtype (future.infer_string, using_string_dtype) with StringArray.__setitem__ validation on pandas.Series.loc.__setitem__.
downstream_effect: Existing tests fail after the upgrade; the root cause combines the default-option flip and the new setitem validation, and the error site is separate from the code that must be edited.
reference_fix: In `toad/impute.py`, `Imputer._replace_empty` now copies `X` and casts `string`-dtype columns to `object`, and `_fit_encode` and `_encode` are rewritten to assign the encoded values through `X.loc[valid, col]` with `.astype(float)` instead of chained `X[col].loc[~mask[col]]` assignment; in `toad/transform.py`, `Transformer._check_duplicated_keys` uses `.tolist()` instead of `.values` for the duplicated column names.
